text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The day of the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan
text_block_list.text:
You can't help but hope for back-to-back Grand Prix titles!
Dream Journey can totally pull it off!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Fan
text_block_list.text:
If it's Buena Vista, she's sure to win today's Arima Kinen too...!
You can do it...!

text_block_list.name: Smartphone Voice
text_block_list.text:
"—Nakayama Racecourse is packed once again today
with fans eagerly awaiting the Arima Kinen—"
...Oh, it connected, it connected.

Well then...
Let's see what you've got, Journey.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
There's just one thing I want to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...With today's 'Arima Kinen',
my "journey" will reach a turning point.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yet this is not the end.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
From here on,
the true "journey" begins once again.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —What about you? What will you do?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is no hesitation.
It has already been decided.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Because I have been on this 'journey'
with her all the way up to today—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Then... let us tie it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
This is a contract of blood and soul...
Unbreakable, inviolable by any mortal hand.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—It was you yourself who wished for this,
Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A rich, deep aroma tickles the nostrils.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I can feel it closer than ever before—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Now... let the dreamlike time begin.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Fans
text_block_list.text:
(Buenaaa! Do your best!!
You're amazing today too!! Don't lose!!
We're rooting for you!! Good luuuck!!)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: You're as popular as ever, Buena-san.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...It was everyone's cheering
that brought me all the way here.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Still, you're not doing too bad yourself, Journey-san...!
Look—

text_block_list.name: Journey's Fans
text_block_list.text:
(Dream Journey!!
Go for back-to-back wins!! You're the strongest!!
Go, Journeyyy!!)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: …………I'm honored.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ......I want to win today.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: No——I will win...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
To face Journey-san with everything I had—with so many people
cheering her on, running that amazing race—and win—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'll bring that "breathtaking view" to everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...What a truly lovely person.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: (And that's exactly why—)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I shall carve it into your memory, so deeply that you will never forget.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: My running... deep into the core of your heart.
